title: Fossa provider, model and provider list metadata v1
description: UTF-8 JSON without BOM, at most 32768 bytes and 64 object/array nesting levels, with Unicode scalar strings and finite numbers. Validate the definition selected by the on-chain account kind. Missing schemaVersion means 1. Provider and model documents permit extensions; list fields are strict. See /docs/technical/metadata for semantic and account-binding rules.

requestsPerWindow.description: Total admitted requests for this provider per window, across all clients and models.

concurrentRequests.description: Total active inference requests for this provider, across all clients and models.

requestLimits.description: Provider-wide runtime admission policy across all models. Fixed windows start with each identity's first admitted request. Counts include admitted inference, including later failures; cancellation does not count. Concurrency lasts until inference stops, including disconnect cleanup. Omitted limits are unspecified. IP and wallet identities are separate soft limits, not unique people. Program offer capacity remains independent. Runtime windows may reset on restart; replicas must share admission state.

endpoint.description: Full HTTPS URL accepting signed inference requests; no credentials or fragment.

image.description: Optional HTTPS image URL; omission or null means no image.

icon.description: Optional HTTPS URL for a simple all-white SVG icon, designed to remain clear at small sizes. Separate from the profile image; clients tint it using accentColor.

id.description: Canonical model identifier; SHA-256 of its exact UTF-8 bytes must equal the on-chain model ID.

aliasOf.description: Retired duplicate model identifier redirects to this canonical model identifier. Must differ from id. Aliases never publish routable offers; targets must exist and must not be aliases.

ordered.description: False when no version is declared. Maintained clients treat this offer as the earliest published version without adding a picker choice.

checkpoints.description: Checkpoint identities, ordered earliest to latest. SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 id bytes identifies an on-chain offer checkpoint. Names are display labels; IDs must be unique. Use Latest when no numbered version exists. If a provider omits its checkpoint, onboarding uses the first ordered identity, or the first identity if none are ordered. Existing offers retain their exact on-chain identities until updated.

modalities.description: Descriptive family modalities. On-chain offer modality masks determine routing eligibility.

contextTokens.description: Descriptive family context limit. Each on-chain offer publishes its own context window.

outputTokens.description: Descriptive family output limit. Each on-chain offer publishes its own maximum output.

inputBoundTokens.description: Descriptive family conservative input limit; defaults to contextTokens and must not exceed it. On-chain offer limits determine eligibility.

capabilities.description: Defaults to tools=false and reasoning=true when effort is present, otherwise false.

effort.description: Client effort labels, ordered from least to most effort. Without variants, labels are sent as reasoning_effort values.

variants.description: Variant IDs must equal effort labels in the same order. Bodies map labels to supported request values and sampling defaults; reasoning_effort may differ from the label.

settings.description: Optional request defaults. maxTokens must not exceed outputTokens.
